- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:17028-17030 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Overflow rows in `security_pass_advisory_backlog` are not filed on later poll ticks while a consolidated fix issue is in progress because the `security-pass-fixing` branch continues before any `security_pass_file_advisory_findings` callsite.
  WHY: Rows above `SECURITY_PASS_ADVISORY_FOLLOWUP_CAP` remain queued for the whole fix-cycle wait, violating the requirement that overflow files on later ticks.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5849-5902, 7030, 17213 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The summary suffix is built only when `SECURITY_PASS_ADVISORY_ROUTED_COUNT > 0`, so backlog issues filed from non-audit paths are omitted from clean or completion tracking comments.
  WHY: Projects that file queued advisory issues through the valid-head or merged-state paths can post completion comments without the routed issue numbers and queued count required by the issue spec.
- .ai/.workspace_source_manifest.txt:166-172, 235-236 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The sorted workspace manifest adds `changelog.d/3928-judge-prompt-pr-diff-byte-cap.md` but omits this PR's `changelog.d/security-pass-line-ownership-poller.md`.
  WHY: The manifest is out of sync with the file tree, so downstream workspace consumers will not see the new fragment and the next regeneration will produce a spurious diff.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:6876-6882, 5863-5882 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: Each re-audit can re-queue already-filed advisory IDs, and the filer counts state-deduped hits against the per-tick cap before `create_security_pass_advisory_followup` returns the existing issue.
  WHY: A cap can be consumed by no-op dedupes, preventing unfiled overflow entries from advancing; moonshotai_kimi-k3 reported that engine-side waiver suppression disproves this concern under the current engine.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:4745, 4748-4751 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: `security_pass_rebind_if_no_new_project_lines` accepts commits with three or more parents as merges, although `git show --format= --cc` does not produce a combined diff for octopus merges.
  WHY: An octopus merge can therefore yield an empty combined-diff file and be marked `passed` without a model audit, admitting unaudited code.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
